subject: Exec converge: scheduling VP/CTO sponsor demo & delegation
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@cloudcore.io>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudcore.io
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec briefing & pilot — VP/CTO attendance?

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — we moved fast internally and want to get the exec briefing scheduled so we can lock the pilot timeline. Two asks from our side: 1) can a VP/CTO-level sponsor attend the demo (this is a revenue-critical pilot for us), and 2) can we confirm a short mutual action plan during that session (pricing + cutover windows)?

Our preliminary procurement window is mid-June — if we can demo with the right sponsor this week or next, that helps. Proposed days: Wed Jun 3 (10:00–10:45 PT), Thu Jun 4 (14:00–14:45 PT), or Tue Jun 9 (10:00–10:45 PT). We prefer Tue Jun 9 if that works.

I attached a short requirements sheet so the demo team can tailor the flow.

Attachments: CloudCore-Pilot-Requirements.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Liam O'Neill
COO, CloudCore
liam.oneill@cloudcore.io
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing & pilot — VP/CTO attendance?

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc (I reviewed it).

We can absolutely get a VP-level sponsor on the call; I need to confirm exact availability. To make this concrete, can you confirm whether you prefer an in-depth architecture slot (45 mins) + 15 minute Q&A, or a shorter executive walkthrough (30 mins) plus separate technical deep-dive? We'll propose people accordingly.

For calendar coordination, here are concrete options (all PT):
- Wed Jun 3 — 10:00–10:45
- Thu Jun 4 — 14:00–14:45
- Tue Jun 9 — 10:00–10:45 (preferred)

If Jun 9 is the target, I will hold a VP slot tentatively and loop in Karthik (SE) and Neha (CS lead) for coverage. I attached a lightweight agenda (v1) so you can tell us whether to emphasize architecture, cost model, or pilot success metrics.

Attachments: Agenda_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Maya
Maya Srinivasan

Hi Maya — Jun 9 10:00–10:45 PT works best for our execs. I can commit to having our Head of Platform (Anna Ruiz) on the line, and I'll push to have our CTO in for the first 20 minutes if schedules allow. For procurement, we need a short mutual action plan on the call to keep to the mid-June timeline — a single slide is fine.

Can you confirm the VP sponsor name and whether Redwood can present a 3-slide MAP (timing, cutover guardrails, cost estimate)? If so, we'll mark this tentatively in our procurement runbook.

Hi all — quick coordination note from the delivery side.

We will plan for a 45-minute exec walkthrough focused on business outcomes, with a 15-minute technical appendix if the CTO joins. Operational plan:
- 09:30 PT: 30-min pre-brief (Redwood internal + CloudCore exec/ops) for slide alignment (join URL will be the same invite)
- 10:00–10:45 PT: Exec demo / MAP review
- 10:45–11:00 PT: Optional technical Q&A (recorded)

Neha will act as the secondary presenter and handle the technical appendix if the CTO is unavailable. Maya — if you can lock the VP sponsor name, I'll draft the deck and share a one-page MAP for procurement.

Calendar note: I can send a calendar invite for Jun 9 and mark the pre-brief at 09:30. Liam — will you want video or phone dial-in?

Thanks,

- Redwood: we'll prepare a 3-slide MAP + 10-min demo; Karthik will circulate deck draft by EOD Jun 7.
